name: lookup_policy
description: Look up a Digit motor policy and return coverage, deductible, expiry, and any open claim. Call this as soon as the caller has given a policy number or vehicle registration for a new claim, coverage question, or existing-claim lookup. Do not call it with guessed IDs. Do not use this tool to register a claim.
pre_call_message: Let me pull up that policy.

policy_number.description: Policy number if the caller provided one, for example POL-DGT-4821. Omit if they only gave a registration.

vehicle_registration.description: Indian vehicle registration as spoken, with or without spaces or hyphens, for example KA03MN4821.

phone.description: Registered mobile number if needed to disambiguate. Prefer {from_number} when available.
